MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

Your piano setup.

Microphone test

Play one key at a time.

Keep your phone near the keyboard’s speaker. Use a clean piano sound, no effects or backing music. No pedal needed.

Version 5 · Shared song score. Audio is processed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. Imported songs and progress are stored in this browser. Recognition needs a real iPhone/keyboard check; noisy rooms and thick chords can confuse a microphone.
A QUICK HELLO

Small sections.
Real progress.

  1. Pick a piece. Start with one hand. Find a comfortable speed.
  2. Put your iPhone near the speaker. Open in Safari, allow microphone access, and calibrate in a quiet room.
  3. Follow the falling notes. Left hand is turquoise, right hand coral. The notes stop until you play the correct pitches. Release between repeated notes. C4 is middle C, the third C from the left.
  4. Make it stick with 7×. Complete a section seven times in a row. A wrong note resets the entire streak. Taking your time is always okay.
For the best view, turn your phone sideways. To install: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.

1 thumb · 2 index · 3 middle · 4 ring · 5 little finger. Suggested fingerings are starting points, not teacher-verified instructions. Difficult reaches may need a different fingering.

Practice and Watch & listen use the same notes and timing. Play notes that arrive together as a chord. Auto listening switches to chord detection when needed; chords remain experimental. For easier practice, choose one hand. Single-note listening only supports passages with one sounding pitch.

7× mode always loops. Your next section unlocks after seven consecutive clean repetitions.
